definition_used: An investigation by the company/institution listed as the affiliation of one or more authors.
caution: The definition describes only the source of investigation (company/institution), not the nature of the problem or manuscript impact. No manuscript-facing category is directly supported without additional context.
semantic_rationale: The reason indicates an institutional investigation, which is a process signal, but does not specify what is being investigated (e.g., data, authorship, ethics). Therefore, no manuscript category can be assigned based solely on this definition.
